description: List the organization's members: userId, name, email, role (owner = admin, manager, member, viewer) and whether they are responsible for orders/tickets. The userIds are what set_org_defaults, add_team_member and list_activity's actorUserId take. Members are login accounts; the person records items get assigned to come from search_resources.
name: list_members

members.description: Login accounts in the org — NOT person records (search_resources)

isYou.description: Present only for the connected user

userId.description: Member userId — the id add_team_member and the assignee defaults want

title: List members
